output.summary: A perennial herb native to the Mediterranean. Its divided leaves are joined by bright yellow flowers with rolled, fringed petal edges and pointed, lobed fruit capsules. In Ethiopia, its seeds flavour stews and its leaves season coffee and tea; dried fruit is also sold as a spice.
